rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance – annual rent increase cap
rules.requirement: Annual residential rent increases are limited to the lower of 3% or 80% of the percent change in CPI over the most recent 12-month period. If CPI is negative, no increase is allowed.
rules.key_value: Lower of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 0% if CPI negative
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in buildings constructed on or before February 1, 1995, and mobile home spaces offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990, in Santa Ana.
rules.exemptions: Residential buildings constructed after February 1, 1995; mobile home spaces first offered for rent after January 1, 1990. Owners may petition the City Manager for a fair-return increase.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Mobile home spaces are covered only if offered for rent on or before January 1, 1990.

rules.quoted_span: Increase in residential rents are limited to the lower of 3% per year, or 80% of the percent change in the Consumer Price Index over the most recent 12-month period.
rules.conflict_note: The page gives no municipal code citation. The state Costa-Hawkins Act may further exempt single-family homes and condominiums, but this page does not say so. The page also does not give the adoption date.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance – just cause required for termination
rules.requirement: After a tenancy has lasted 30 days, the owner may terminate it only for an enumerated at-fault or no-fault just cause, stated in a written notice. For curable violations, the owner must first give a notice with time to cure.
rules.key_value: Just cause required after 30 days of tenancy
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental tenancies in Santa Ana lasting more than 30 days.
rules.exemptions: Housing produced in the last 15 years; deed-restricted affordable housing; hotel and transient occupancy; hospital and care facilities; dormitories; other shared living quarters.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exempts deed-restricted affordable housing, transient occupancy, care facilities, dormitories and shared living quarters; the tenancy must exceed 30 days.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (2021)
rules.quoted_span: After 30 days, an owner shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause, which shall be stated in a written notice.
rules.conflict_note: The page says 'housing produced in the last 15 years' without stating whether this is measured by construction date or certificate of occupancy. No municipal code citation is given.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance – no-fault relocation assistance
rules.requirement: For a no-fault just cause termination, the owner must either pay 3 months of relocation assistance or waive rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: 3 months' relocation assistance or 3 months' rent waiver
rules.coverage_conditions: No-fault terminations of tenancies covered by the Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Same as the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance: housing produced in the last 15 years, deed-restricted affordable housing, transient occupancy, care facilities, dormitories and shared living quarters.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to no-fault terminations; exempts deed-restricted affordable housing and other listed property types.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (2021)
rules.quoted_span: Under a no-fault just cause termination, the owner shall either provide 3 months of relocation assistance or waive payment of rent for the final 3 months of the tenancy.

rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance – tenant rights notice
rules.requirement: Owners must give tenants written notice of the Rent Stabilization Ordinance and tenant rights at the start of a lease and with any rent increase notice.
rules.coverage_conditions: Owners of residential rental property subject to the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Presumably limited to units covered by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance; the page does not specify.

rules.quoted_span: Property owners are required to provide written notice of the Ordinance and tenant’s rights at commencement of a lease or as part of any notice to increase rent.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance – tenant protections notice
rules.requirement: Owners must notify tenants of the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance protections: existing tenants before December 19, 2021, and others at lease commencement or renewal.
rules.coverage_conditions: Owners of residential rental property covered by the Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Same as the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Exempts deed-restricted affordable housing and other listed property types.

rules.citation: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (2021)
rules.quoted_span: Property owners must provide notice to existing tenants before December 19, 2021, or at commencement or renewal of their lease of the Just Cause Eviction Ordinance protections.
